subject.title: [Feature]: Semantic Message Aggregation: merge rapid-fire short messages and split multi-topic long messages

question: Should OpenClaw add a generic session-ingress semantic aggregation design here, narrow this to the existing adaptive-debounce tracker, or reject long-message topic splitting for core?
rationale: The remaining behavior changes turn boundaries and config/API surface, so code inspection cannot choose the desired UX, defaults, and compatibility policy without maintainer intent.

options.title: Design one generic ingress contract
options.body: Keep this open while maintainers define an opt-in generic aggregation policy with preserved bundle metadata, adaptive timing rules, and explicit topic-splitting semantics.

options.title: Narrow to adaptive debounce only
options.body: Let https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/57123 own timing behavior and close or retitle this issue to remove semantic long-message splitting from scope.

options.title: Reject semantic splitting in core
options.body: Document fixed debounce as the supported core behavior and leave semantic preprocessing to plugins or user prompts unless a missing plugin API is identified.

recommendation.title: Design one generic ingress contract
recommendation.body: Keep this open while maintainers define an opt-in generic aggregation policy with preserved bundle metadata, adaptive timing rules, and explicit topic-splitting semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: The shared inbound debounce policy and related maintainer-side reviews most consistently route through steipete's recent history on this surface.
